verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores data locally as plain-text Markdown, and Sync offers end-to-end encryption where 'no one — not even the Obsidian team — can access your notes,' which inherently prevents Obsidian from using data for AI training. However, there is no explicit policy statement or ToS excerpt addressing AI training use, and community evidence questions the ability to verify the security model since Obsidian is closed source. missing for 10: an explicit AI-training-data policy/opt-out statement, independent verification of the no-access claim, and clarity on any AI features (e.g., Copilot integrations) that might process vault content externally.
